question: In India which of the following statements regarding Fundamental Duty is NOT correct ?

options.text: Total number of Fundamental Duties are 11
Article 51 - A is related to Fundamental Duties
Incorporated in Part IV - A of the Constitution

solution:
The correct answer is Inserted by __**43rd Constitutional Amendment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Forty-third Amendment of the Constitution of India,** formally titled the **Constitution Act of 1977**, annulled six articles that were introduced into the Constitution through the 42nd Amendment. 
 
• The 42nd Amendment was enacted during the Emergency under the leadership of Indira Gandhi and the Indian National Congress.
